name: openmoe.ai — OpenMoE-BFT: Byzantine-fault-tolerant MoE routing + A2A compliance
description: Open-source BFT consensus layer for Mixture-of-Experts routing: every routing decision is fanned out to N router replicas and dispatched only on a 2f+1 quorum, governed by the 14 OpenScore safety experts. Ships a 9-module EU-AI-Act / A2A compliance toolkit (19 conformity checks, Articles 9-15), hash-chained cryptographic receipts (HMAC-SHA256 / Ed25519), hierarchical L0-L3 memory, covenants & web-of-trust, and red-team orchestration. Apache-2.0, Python 3.10+, stdlib-only core, MCP server included.

provider.organization: MEOK AI Labs (CSOAI LTD, UK Companies House 16939677)

skills.name: BFT MoE routing decision
skills.description: Fan a routing decision out to N router replicas; dispatch only when a 2f+1 quorum agrees (f = floor((n-1)/3)). BFTRouter, BFTLedger, quorum arithmetic.
examples: Route this token through a 4-replica BFT quorum
What is the quorum size for 7 router replicas?

skills.name: Robust router-logit fusion
skills.description: Coordinate-wise median, trimmed mean, Krum / Multi-Krum aggregation over numeric router logits — single compromised replica cannot skew the route.

skills.name: Debate consensus
skills.description: Proposers refine positions across rounds; the BFT ledger decides. Multi-agent deliberation with a tamper-evident outcome.

skills.name: EU AI Act conformity checks
skills.description: 19 conformity checks across Articles 9-15 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, runnable against an MoE/agent deployment.

skills.name: Cryptographic receipts
skills.description: Hash-chained, tamper-evident receipts for every routing/consensus decision (HMAC-SHA256, optional Ed25519).

skills.name: A2A agent-card validation
skills.description: validate_agent_card — validate A2A Agent Cards against the EU AI Act and the 14 OpenScore safety experts. Used fleet-wide as the CI check for .well-known/agent.json.
examples: Validate this agent.json against the EU AI Act

skills.name: Red-team orchestration
skills.description: Pluggable attack strategies probe a target agent/router and score resilience 0..1.

skills.name: Hierarchical memory + dream()
skills.description: L0-L3 memory pyramid with an overnight dream() consolidation pass.

skills.name: Covenants & web-of-trust
skills.description: Agents pre-commit to allowed actions; breaches degrade a trust score across the web-of-trust.

x402.name: X-PAYMENT
x402.description: x402 pay-per-call (pip install "openmoe-bft[x402]"). Core is free/Apache-2.0.
